morceaux.1: Fasti Liber secundus P. OVIDI NASONIS FASTORVM LIBER SECVNDVS
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Ianus habet finem. cum carmine crescit et annus:</l>
  <l n="2">alter ut hic mensis, sic liber alter eat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="3">nunc primum velis, elegi, maioribus itis:</l>
  <l n="4">exiguum, memini, nuper eratis opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">ipse ego vos habui faciles in amore ministros,</l>
  <l n="6">cum lusit numeris prima iuventa suis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="7">idem sacra cano signataque tempora fastis:</l>
  <l n="8">ecquis ad haec illinc crederet esse viam?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">haec mea militia est; ferimus quae possumus arma,</l>
  <l n="10">dextraque non omni munere nostra vacat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">si mihi non valido torquentur pila lacerto</l>
  <l n="12">nec bellatoris terga premuntur equi,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">nec galea tegimur, nec acuto cingimur ense</l>
  <l n="14">(his habilis telis quilibet esse potest),</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15">at tua prosequimur studioso pectore, Caesar,</l>
  <l n="16">nomina, per titulos ingredimurque tuos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">ergo ades et placido paulum mea munera voltu</l>
  <l n="18">respice, pacando siquid ab hoste vacat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">Februa Romani dixere piamina patres:</l>
  <l n="20">nunc quoque dant verbo plurima signa fidem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">pontifices ab rege petunt et flamine lanas,</l>
  <l n="22">quis veterum lingua februa nomen erat;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">quaeque capit lictor domibus purgamina certis,</l>
  <l n="24">torrida cum mica farra, vocantur idem;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">nomen idem ramo, qui caesus ab arbore pura</l>
  <l n="26">casta sacerdotum tempora fronde tegit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">ipse ego flaminicam poscentem februa vidi;</l>
  <l n="28">februa poscenti pinea virga data est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">denique quodcumque est quo corpora nostra piantur,</l>
  <l n="30">hoc apud intonsos nomen habebat avos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">mensis ab his dictus, secta quia pelle Luperci</l>
  <l n="32">omne solum lustrant, idque piamen habent;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.3:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">aut quia placatis sunt tempora pura sepulcris,</l>
  <l n="34">tum cum ferales praeteriere dies.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="35">omne nefas omnemque mali purgamina causam</l>
  <l n="36">credebant nostri tollere posse senes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="37">Graecia principium moris dedit: illa nocentes</l>
  <l n="38">impia lustratos ponere facta putat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="39">Actoriden <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Peleus</name>, ipsum quoque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Pelea</name> <persName>Phoci</persName></l>
  <l n="40">caede per Haemonias solvit <persName>Acastus</persName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquas</name>;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="41">vectam frenatis per inane <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">draconibus</name> <persName>Aegeus</persName></l>
  <l n="42">credulus immerita <persName>Phasida</persName> fovit ope;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="43"><persName>Amphiareiades</persName> <placeName>Naupactoo</placeName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Acheloo</name></l>
  <l n="44">'solve nefas' dixit, solvit et ille nefas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="45">ah nimium faciles, qui tristia crimina caedis</l>
  <l n="46">fluminea tolli posse putatis aqua!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="47">Sed tamen, antiqui ne nescius ordinis erres,</l>
  <l n="48">primus, ut est, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iani</name> mensis et ante fuit;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="49">qui sequitur <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Ianum</name>, veteris fuit ultimus anni:</l>
  <l n="50">tu quoque sacrorum, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Termine</name>, finis eras.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="51">primus enim <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iani</name> mensis, quia ianua prima est:</l>
  <l n="52">qui sacer est imis manibus, imus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="53">postmodo creduntur spatio distantia longo</l>
  <l n="54">tempora bis quini continuasse viri.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="54a"/>
morceaux.4:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="57">Principio mensis Phrygiae contermina Matri</l>
  <l n="58">Sospita delubris dicitur aucta novis.</l>
  <l n="59">nunc ubi sunt, illis quae sunt sacrata Kalendis</l>
  <l n="60">templa deae? longa procubuere die.</l>
  <l n="61">cetera ne simili caderent labefacta ruina</l>
  <l n="62"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">cavis</name> sacrati provida cura ducis,</l>
  <l n="63">sub quo delubris sentitur nulla senectus;</l>
  <l n="64">nec satis est homines, obligat ille deos.</l>
  <l n="65">templorum positor, templorum sancte repostor,</l>
  <l n="66">sit superis opto mutua cura tui.</l>
  <l n="67">dent tibi caelestes, quos tu caelestibus, annos,</l>
  <l n="68">proque tua maneant in statione domo.</l>
  <l n="69">tum quoque vicini lucus celebratur Alerni,</l>
  <l n="70">qua petit aequoreas advena <placeName>Thybris</placeName> aquas.</l>
  <l n="71">ad penetrale <persName>Numae</persName> Capitolinumque <name type="deity">Tonantem</name></l>
  <l n="72">inque <name type="deity">Iovis</name> summa caeditur arce bidens.</l>
  <l n="73">saepe graves pluvias adopertus nubibus aether</l>
  <l n="74">concitat, aut posita sub nive terra latet.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="72a"/>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="75">Proximus <name type="deity">Hesperias</name> <persName>Titan</persName> abiturus in undas</l>
  <l n="76">gemmea purpureis cum iuga demet equis,</l>
  <l n="77">illa nocte aliquis, tollens ad sidera voltum,</l>
  <l n="78">dicet 'ubi est hodie quae <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Lyra</name> fulsit heri?'</l>
  <l n="79">dumque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Lyram</name> quaeret, medii quoque terga <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Leonis</name></l>
  <l n="80">in liquidas subito mersa notabit aquas.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="78a"/>
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="81">Quem modo caelatum stellis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Delphina</name> videbas,</l>
  <l n="82">is fugiet visus nocte sequente tuos,</l>
  <l n="83">seu fuit occultis felix in amoribus index,</l>
  <l n="84"><persName>Lesbida</persName> cum domino seu tulit ille lyram.</l>
  <l n="85">quod mare non novit, quae nescit <persName>Ariona</persName> tellus?</l>
  <l n="86">carmine currentes ille tenebat aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="87">saepe sequens <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">agnam</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupus</name> est a voce retentus,</l>
  <l n="88">saepe avidum fugiens restitit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">agna</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupum</name>;</l>
  <l n="89">saepe <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leporesque</name> umbra iacuere sub una,</l>
  <l n="90">et stetit in saxo proxima <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">cerva</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leae</name>,</l>
  <l n="91">et sine lite loquax cum <name type="deity">Palladis</name> alite <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">cornix</name></l>
  <l n="92">sedit, et <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">accipitri</name> iuncta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">columba</name> fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="93"><name type="deity">Cynthia</name> saepe tuis fertur, vocalis <persName>Arion</persName>,</l>
  <l n="94">tamquam fraternis obstipuisse modis.</l>
  <l n="95">nomen <foreign xml:lang="la">Arionium</foreign> <placeName>Siculas</placeName> impleverat urbes</l>
  <l n="96">captaque erat lyricis <persName>Ausonis</persName> ora sonis;</l>
  <l n="97">inde domum repetens puppem conscendit <persName>Arion</persName>,</l>
  <l n="98">atque ita quaesitas arte ferebat opes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="99">forsitan, infelix, ventos undasque timebas:</l>
  <l n="100">at tibi nave tua tutius aequor erat.</l>
  <l n="101">namque gubernator destricto constitit ense</l>
  <l n="102">ceteraque armata conscia turba manu.</l>
  <l n="103">quid tibi cum gladio? dubiam rege, navita, puppem:</l>
  <l n="104">non haec sunt digitis arma tenenda tuis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="105">ille, metu pavidus, 'mortem non deprecor' inquit,</l>
  <l n="106">'sed liceat sumpta pauca referre lyra.'</l>
  <l n="107">dant veniam ridentque moram: capit ille coronam,</l>
  <l n="108">quae possit crines, <name type="deity">Phoebe</name>, decere tuos;</l>
  <l n="109">induerat <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">Tyrio</name> bis tinctam <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">murice</name> pallam:</l>
  <l n="110">reddidit icta suos pollice chorda sonos,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="111">flebilibus numeris veluti canentia dura</l>
  <l n="112">traiectus penna tempora cantat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">olor</name>.</l>
  <l n="113">protinus in medias ornatus desilit undas;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="112">spargitur impulsa caerula puppis aqua.</l>
  <l n="113">inde <foreign xml:lang="la">(fide maius)</foreign> tergo delphina recurvo</l>
  <l n="114">se memorant oneri subposuisse novo.</l>
  <l n="115">ille, sedens <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">citharam</name>que tenens, pretiumque vehendi</l>
  <l n="116">cantat et aequoreas carmine mulcet aquas.</l>
  <l n="117">di pia facta vident: astris <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">delphinam</name> recepit</l>
  <l n="118">Iuppiter et stellas iussit habere novem.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.7:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Nunc mihi <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">mille</name> sonos quoque est memoratus <persName>A<foreign xml:lang="grc">χι</foreign>lles</persName></l>
  <l n="2">uellem, <persName>Maeonide</persName>, pectus inesse tuum,</l>
  <l n="3">dum canimus sacras alterno carmine <name type="deity">Nonas</name>.</l>
  <l n="4">maximus hic fastis accumulatur honor.</l>
  <l n="5">deficit ingenium, maioraque uiribus urgent:</l>
  <l n="6">haec mihi praecipuo est ore canenda dies.</l>
  <l n="7">quid uolui demens elegis imponere tantum</l>
  <l n="8">ponderis? heroi res erat ista pedis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">sancte pater patriae, tibi plebs, tibi <placeName>curia</placeName> nomen</l>
  <l n="10">hoc dedit, hoc dedimus nos tibi nomen, <persName>eques</persName>.</l>
  <l n="11">res tamen ante dedit: sero quoque uera tulisti</l>
  <l n="12">nomina, iam pridem tu pater <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">orbis</name> eras.</l>
  <l n="13">hoc tu per terras, quod in aethere <name type="deity">Iuppiter</name> alto,</l>
  <l n="14">nomen habes: hominum tu pater, ille deum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15"><persName>Romule</persName>, concedes: facit hic tua magna tuendo</l>
  <l n="16">moenia, tu dederas transilienda <persName>Remo</persName>.</l>
  <l n="17">te <persName>Tatius</persName> paruique <placeName>Cures</placeName> <placeName>Caenina</placeName>que sensit,</l>
  <l n="18">hoc duce <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Romanum</name> est solis utrumque latus;</l>
  <l n="19">tu breve nescioquid uictae telluris habebas,</l>
  <l n="20">quodcumque est alto sub <name type="deity">Ioue</name>, <persName>Caesar</persName> habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">tu rapis, hic castas duce se iubet esse maritas;</l>
  <l n="22">tu recipis luco, reppulit ille nefas;</l>
  <l n="23">uis tibi grata fuit, florent sub <persName>Caesare</persName> leges;</l>
  <l n="24">tu domini nomen, principis ille tenet;</l>
  <l n="25">te <persName>Remus</persName> incusat, ueniam dedit hostibus ille;</l>
  <l n="26">caelestem fecit te pater, ille patrem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">Iam puer <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Idaeus</name> media tenus eminet aluo,</l>
  <l n="28">et liquidas mixto nectare fundit aquas.</l>
  <l n="29">en etiam, siquis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Borean</name> horrere solebat,</l>
  <l n="30">gaudeat: a <name type="deity">Zephyris</name> mollior aura uenit.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.8: Halieutica Quintus ab aequoreis nitidum iubar extulit undis Lucifer, et primi tempora veris erunt. ne fallare tamen, restant tibi frigora, restant, magnaque discedens signa reliquit hiems. B N 12. C N 152a
morceaux.9:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="153">Tertia nox veniat, <persName>Custodem</persName> protinus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Ursae</name></l>
  <l n="154">aspicies geminos exseruisse pedes.</l>
  <l n="155">inter <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hamadryadas</name> iaculatricemque <name type="deity">Dianam</name></l>
  <l n="156"><persName>Callisto</persName> sacri pars fuit una <foreign xml:lang="la">chori</foreign>.</l>
  <l n="157">illa, <name type="deity">deae</name> tangens arcus, 'quos tangimus arcus,</l>
  <l n="158">este meae testes virginitatis' ait.</l>
  <l n="159"><name type="deity">Cynthia</name> laudavit, 'promissa' que 'foedera serva,</l>
  <l n="160">et comitum princeps tu mihi' dixit 'eris.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="161">foedera servasset, si non formosa fuisset:</l>
  <l n="162">cavit mortales, de <name type="deity">Iove</name> crimen habet.</l>
  <l n="163">mille <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">feras</name> <name type="deity">Phoebe</name> silvis venata redibat</l>
  <l n="164">aut plus aut medium sole tenente diem;</l>
  <l n="165">ut tetigit lucum (densa niger ilice lucus,</l>
  <l n="166">in medio gelidae fons erat altus aquae),</l>
  <l n="167">'hic' ait 'in silva, <persName>virgo Tegeaea</persName>, lavemur';</l>
  <l n="168">erubuit falso virginis illa sono.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="169">dixerat et nymphis. nymphae velamina ponunt;</l>
  <l n="170">hanc pudet, et tardae dat mala signa morae.</l>
  <l n="171">exuerat tunicas; uteri manifesta tumore</l>
  <l n="172">proditur indicio ponderis ipsa suo.</l>
  <l n="173">cui <name type="deity">dea</name> 'virgineos, <persName>periura Lycaoni</persName>, coetus</l>
  <l n="174">desere, nec castas pollue' dixit 'aquas.'</l>
  <l n="175">luna novum decies implerat cornibus orbem:</l>
  <l n="176">quae fuerat virgo credita, mater erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="177">laesa furit <name type="deity">Iuno</name>, formam mutatque puellae:</l>
  <l n="178">quid facis? invito est pectore passa <name type="deity">Iovem</name>.</l>
  <l n="179">utque ferae vidit turpes in paelice voltus,</l>
  <l n="180">'huius in amplexus, <name type="deity">Iuppiter</name>,' inquit 'eas.'</l>
  <l n="181"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ursa</name> per incultos errabat squalida montes</l>
  <l n="182">quae fuerat summo nuper amata <name type="deity">Iovi</name>.</l>
  <l n="183">iam tria lustra puer furto conceptus agebat,</l>
  <l n="184">cum mater nato est obvia facta suo.</l>
  <l n="185">illa quidem, tamquam cognosceret, adstitit amens,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.10:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="190">et gemuit: gemitus verba parentis erant.</l>
  <l n="191">hanc puer ignarus iaculo fixisset acuto</l>
  <l n="192">ni foret in superas raptus uterque domos.</l>
  <l n="193">signa propinqua micant: prior est, quam dicimus Arcton,</l>
  <l n="194"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Arctophylax</name> formam terga sequentis habet.</l>
  <l n="195">saevit adhuc canamque rogat <name type="deity">Saturnia</name> <name type="deity">Tethyn</name></l>
  <l n="196"><name type="placeName">Maenaliam</name> tactis ne lavet <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Arcton</name> aquis.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.11:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="193">Idibus agrestis fumant altaria <name type="deity">Fauni</name></l>
  <l n="194">hic ubi discretas insula rumpit aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="195">haec fuit illa dies in qua <placeName>Veientibus</placeName> armis</l>
  <l n="196">ter centum <persName>Fabii</persName> ter cecidere duo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="197">una domus vires et onus susceperat urbis:</l>
  <l n="198">sumunt gentiles arma professa manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="199">egreditur castris miles generosus ab isdem,</l>
  <l n="200">e quis dux fieri quilibet aptus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="201"><placeName>Carmentis</placeName> portae dextro est via proxima iano:</l>
  <l n="202">ire per hanc noli, quisquis es; omen habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="203">illa fama refert <persName>Fabios</persName> exisse trecentos:</l>
  <l n="204">porta vacat culpa, sed tamen omen habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="205">ut celeri passu <placeName>Cremeram</placeName> tetigere rapacem</l>
  <l n="206">(turbidus hibernis ille fluebat aquis),</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="207">castra loco ponunt: destrictis ensibus ipsi</l>
  <l n="208">Tyrrhenum valido Marte per agmen eunt;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="209">non aliter quam cum Libyca de gente <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leones</name></l>
  <l n="210">invadunt sparsos lata per arva greges.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="211">diffugiunt hostes inhonestaque volnera tergo</l>
  <l n="212">accipiunt: Tusco sanguine terra rubet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="213">sic iterum, sic saepe cadunt; ubi vincere aperte</l>
  <l n="214">non datur, insidias armaque tecta parant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="215">campus erat, campi claudebant ultima colles</l>
  <l n="216">silvaque montanas occulere apta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">feras</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="217">in medio paucos armentaque rara relinquunt,</l>
  <l n="218">cetera virgultis abdita turba latet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="219">ecce velut torrens undis pluvialibus auctus</l>
  <l n="220">aut nive, quae <foreign xml:lang="grc">Zephyro</foreign> victa tepente fluit,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="221">per sata perque vias fertur nec, ut ante solebat,</l>
  <l n="222">riparum clausas margine finit aquas,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="223">sic <persName>Fabii</persName> vallem latis discursibus implent,</l>
  <l n="224">quodque vident sternunt, nec metus alter inest.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.12:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="225">quo ruitis, <persName>generosa</persName> domus? male creditis hosti:</l>
  <l n="226">simplex nobilitas, perfida tela cave.</l>
  <l n="227">fraude perit virtus: in apertos undique campos</l>
  <l n="228">prosiliunt hostes et latus omne tenent.</l>
  <l n="229">quid faciant pauci contra tot milia fortes?</l>
  <l n="230">quidve, quod in misero tempore restet, adest?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="231">sicut <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aper</name> longe silvis latratibus actus</l>
  <l n="232"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">fulmineo</name> celeres dissipat ore <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name>,</l>
  <l n="233">mox tamen ipse perit, sic non moriuntur inulti,</l>
  <l n="234">volneraque alterna dantque feruntque manu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="235">una dies <persName>Fabios</persName> ad bellum miserat omnes,</l>
  <l n="236">ad bellum missos perdidit una dies.</l>
  <l n="237">ut tamen <name type="deity">Herculeae</name> superessent semina gentis,</l>
  <l n="238">credibile est ipsos consuluisse deos:</l>
  <l n="239">nam puer impubes et adhuc non utilis armis</l>
  <l n="240">unus de <persName>Fabia</persName> gente relictus erat;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="241">scilicet ut posses olim tu, <persName>Maxime</persName>, nasci,</l>
  <l n="242">cui res cunctando restituenda foret.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="14"/>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="242a">E N</l>
</lg>
morceaux.13:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="243">Continuata loco tria sidera, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Corvus</name> et <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Anguis</name></l>
  <l n="244">et medius <name type="object" xml:lang="la">Crater</name> inter utrumque, iacent.</l>
  <l n="245">Idibus illa latent, oriuntur nocte sequenti;</l>
  <l n="246">quae, tibi, cur tria sint tam sociata, canam.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="247">forte <persName>Iovi</persName> <persName>Phoebus</persName> festum sollemne parabat</l>
  <l n="248">(non faciet longas fabula nostra moras):</l>
  <l n="249">'i, mea' dixit 'avis, ne quid pia sacra moretur,</l>
  <l n="250">et tenuem vivis fontibus adfer aquam.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="251"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">corvus</name> inauratum pedibus <name type="object" xml:lang="la">cratera</name> recurvis</l>
  <l n="252">tollit et aerium pervolat altus iter.</l>
  <l n="253">stabat adhuc duris ficus densissima pomis:</l>
  <l n="254">temptat eam rostro, non erat apta legi;</l>
  <l n="255">immemor imperii sedisse sub arbore fertur,</l>
  <l n="256">dum fierent tarda dulcia poma mora.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="257">iamque satur nigris longum rapit unguibus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hydrum</name>,</l>
  <l n="258">ad dominumque redit, fictaque verba refert:</l>
  <l n="259">'hic mihi causa morae, vivarum obsessor aquarum:</l>
  <l n="260">hic tenuit fontes officiumque meum.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="261">'addis' ait 'culpae mendacia' <persName>Phoebus</persName> 'et audes</l>
  <l n="262">fatidicum verbis fallere velle deum?</l>
  <l n="263">at tibi, dum lactens haerebit in arbore ficus,</l>
  <l n="264">de nullo gelidae fonte bibentur aquae.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="265">dixit, et, antiqui monimenta perennia facti,</l>
  <l n="266"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Anguis</name>, avis, <name type="object" xml:lang="la">Crater</name> sidera iuncta micant.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="15"/>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="266a">F LVPER : NP</l>
</lg>
morceaux.14:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="267">Tertia post Idus <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Idu</name> nudos <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Lupercos</name></l>
  <l n="268">aspicit, et <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Fauni</name> sacra bicornis eunt.</l>
  <l n="269">dicite, <persName>Pierides</persName>, sacrorum quae sit origo,</l>
  <l n="270">attigerint <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Latias</name> unde petita domos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="271"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Pana</name> deum pecoris veteres coluisse feruntur</l>
  <l n="272"><name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Arcades</name>; <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Arcadiis</name> plurimus ille iugis.</l>
  <l n="273">testis erit <placeName>Pholoe</placeName>, testes <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Stymphalides</name> undae,</l>
  <l n="274">quique citis <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Ladon</name> in mare currit aquis,</l>
  <l n="275">cinctaque pinetis nemoris iuga <placeName>Nonacrini</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="276">altaque <placeName>Tricrene</placeName> <placeName>Parrhasiae</placeName>que nives.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="277"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Pan</name> erat armenti, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Pan</name> illic numen equarum,</l>
  <l n="278">munus ob incolumes ille ferebat oves.</l>
  <l n="279">transtulit <persName>Euander</persName> silvestria numina secum:</l>
  <l n="280">hic, ubi nunc urbs est, tum locus urbis erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="281">inde deum colimus devectaque sacra <foreign xml:lang="grc">Πελασγοῖς</foreign>:</l>
  <l n="282">flamen ad haec prisco more <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Dialis</name> erat.</l>
  <l n="283">cur igitur currant, et cur (sic currere mos est)</l>
  <l n="284">nuda ferant posita corpora veste, rogas?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="285">ipse deus velox discurrere gaudet in altis</l>
  <l n="286">montibus, et subitas concipit ipse fugas:</l>
  <l n="287">ipse deus nudus nudos iubet ire ministros;</l>
  <l n="288">nec satis ad cursus commoda vestis erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="289">ante <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovem</name> genitum terras habuisse feruntur</l>
  <l n="290"><name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Arcades</name>, et <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">luna</name> gens prior illa fuit.</l>
  <l n="291">vita feris similis, nullos agitata per usus:</l>
  <l n="292">artis adhuc expers et rude volgus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="293">pro domibus frondes norant, pro frugibus <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbas</name>;</l>
  <l n="294"><name type="plant" xml:lang="la">nectar</name> erat palmis hausta duabus aqua.</l>
  <l n="295">nullus anhelabat sub adunco vomere <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">taurus</name>,</l>
  <l n="296">nulla sub imperio terra colentis erat:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="297">nullus adhuc erat usus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equi</name>; se quisque ferebat:</l>
  <l n="298">ibat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovis</name> lana corpus amicta sua.</l>
  <l n="299">sub <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iove</name> durabant et corpora nuda gerebant,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.15:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="300">docta graves imbres et tolerare <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Notos</name>.</l>
  <l n="301">nunc quoque detecti referunt monimenta vetusti</l>
  <l n="302">moris, et antiquas testificantur opes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="303">Sed cur praecipue fugiat velamina <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Faunus</name>,</l>
  <l n="304">traditur antiqui fabula plena ioci.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="305">forte comes dominae iuvenis <persName>Tirynthius</persName> ibat:</l>
  <l n="306">vidit ab excelso <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Faunus</name> utrumque iugo;</l>
  <l n="307">vidit et incaluit, '<foreign xml:lang="la">montana</foreign>' que '<foreign xml:lang="la">numina</foreign>', dixit</l>
  <l n="308">'nil mihi vobiscum est: hic meus ardor erit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="309">ibat odoratis umeros perfusa capillis</l>
  <l n="310"><name type="person" xml:lang="la">Maeonis</name>, aurato conspicienda sinu:</l>
  <l n="311">aurea pellebant tepidos umbracula soles,</l>
  <l n="312">quae tamen <persName>Herculeae</persName> sustinuere manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="313">iam <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Bacchi</name> nemus et <placeName>Tmoli</placeName> vineta tenebat,</l>
  <l n="314"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Hesperos</name> et fusco roscidus ibat equo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="315">antra subit tofis laqueata et pumice vivo;</l>
  <l n="316">garrulus in primo limine rivus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="317">dumque parant epulas potandaque vina ministri,</l>
  <l n="318">cultibus <persName>Alciden</persName> instruit illa suis:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="319">dat tenues tunicas <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Gaetulo</name> murice tinctas,</l>
  <l n="320">dat teretem zonam, qua modo cincta fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="321">ventre minor zona est; tunicarum vincla relaxat,</l>
  <l n="322">ut posset magnas exseruisse manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="323">fregerat armillas non illa ad bracchia factas,</l>
  <l n="324">scindebant magni vincula parva pedes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="325">ipsa capit clavamque gravem spoliumque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leonis</name></l>
  <l n="326">conditaque in pharetra tela minora sua.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="327">sic epulis functi sic dant sua corpora somno,</l>
  <l n="328">et positis iuxta secubuere toris:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="329">causa, repertori <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">vitis</name> quia sacra parabant,</l>
  <l n="330">quae facerent pure, cum foret orta dies.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">noctis erat medium. quid non amor improbus audet?</l>
  <l n="32">roscida per tenebras <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Faunus</name> ad antra venit:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.16:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="333">utque videt comites somno vinoque solutos,</l>
  <l n="334">spem capit in dominis esse soporis idem.</l>
  <l n="335">intrat et huc illuc temerarius errat adulter,</l>
  <l n="336">et praefert cautas subsequiturque manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="337">venerat ad strati captata cubilia lecti,</l>
  <l n="338">et felix prima sorte futurus erat;</l>
  <l n="339">ut tetigit fulvi saetis hirsuta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leonis</name></l>
  <l n="340">vellera, pertimuit sustinuitque manum,</l>
  <l n="341">attonitusque metu rediit, ut saepe viator</l>
  <l n="342">turbatum viso rettulit angue pedem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="343">inde tori qui iunctus erat velamina tangit</l>
  <l n="344">mollia, mendaci decipiturque nota.</l>
  <l n="345">ascendit spondaque sibi propiore recumbit,</l>
  <l n="346">et tumidum cornu durius inguen erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="347">interea tunicas ora subducit ab ima:</l>
  <l n="348">horrebant densis aspera crura pilis.</l>
  <l n="349">cetera temptantem subito Tirynthius heros</l>
  <l n="350">reppulit: e summo decidit ille toro.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="351">fit sonus, inclamat comites et lumina poscit</l>
  <l n="352">Maeonis: inlatis ignibus acta patent.</l>
  <l n="353">ille gemit lecto graviter deiectus ab alto,</l>
  <l n="354">membraque de dura vix sua tollit humo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="355">ridet et Alcides et qui videre iacentem,</l>
  <l n="356">ridet amatorem Lyda puella suum.</l>
  <l n="357">veste deus lusus fallentes lumina vestes</l>
  <l n="358">non amat, et nudos ad sua sacra vocat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="359">Adde peregrinis causas, mea Musa, Latinas,</l>
  <l n="360">inque suo noster pulvere currat equus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="361">cornipedi Fauno caesa de more capella</l>
  <l n="362">venit ad exiguas turba vocata dapes.</l>
  <l n="363">dumque sacerdotes veribus transuta salignis</l>
  <l n="364">exta parant, medias sole tenente vias,</l>
  <l n="365">Romulus et frater pastoralisque iuventus</l>
  <l n="366">solibus et campo corpora nuda dabant.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.17:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="369">vectibus et iaculis et misso pondere <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">saxi</name></l>
  <l n="370">bracchia per lusus experienda dabant:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="371">pastor ab excelso 'per devia rura <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">iuvencos</name>,</l>
  <l n="372"><persName>Romule</persName>, praedones, et <persName>Reme</persName>', dixit 'agunt.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="373">longum erat armari: diversis exit uterque</l>
  <l n="374">partibus, occursu praeda recepta <persName>Remi</persName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="375">ut rediit, veribus stridentia detrahit exta</l>
  <l n="376">atque ait 'haec certe non nisi victor edet.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="377">dicta facit, <persName>Fabiique</persName> simul. venit inritus illuc</l>
  <l n="378"><persName>Romulus</persName> et mensas ossaque nuda videt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="379">risit, et indoluit <persName>Fabios</persName> potuisse <persName>Remumque</persName></l>
  <l n="380">vincere, <persName>Quintilios</persName> non potuisse suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="381">forma manet facti: posito velamine currunt,</l>
  <l n="382">et memorem famam quod bene cessit habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="383">Forsitan et quaeras cur sit locus ille <placeName>Lupercal</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="384">quaeve diem tali nomine causa notet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="385"><persName>Silvia</persName> <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Vestalis</name> caelestia semina partu</l>
  <l n="386">ediderat, patruo regna tenente suo;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="387">is iubet auferri parvos et in amne necari:</l>
  <l n="388">quid facis? ex istis <persName>Romulus</persName> alter erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="389">iussa recusantes peragunt lacrimosa ministri</l>
  <l n="390">(flent tamen) et geminos in loca sola ferunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="391"><placeName>Albula</placeName>, quem <placeName>Tiberim</placeName> mersus <persName>Tiberinus</persName> in undis</l>
  <l n="392">reddidit, hibernis forte tumebat aquis:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="393">hic, ubi nunc fora sunt, lintres errare videres,</l>
  <l n="394">quaque iacent valles, <persName>Maxime</persName> <placeName>Circe</placeName>, tuae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="395">huc ubi venerunt (neque enim procedere possunt</l>
  <l n="396">longius), ex illis unus et alter ait:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="397">'at quam sunt similes! at quam formosus uterque!</l>
  <l n="398">plus tamen ex illis iste vigoris habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="399">si genus arguitur voltu, nisi fallit imago,</l>
  <l n="400">nescioquem in vobis suspicor esse <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">deum</name>.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.18:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="400">at siquis vestrae deus esset originis auctor,</l>
  <l n="401">in tam praecipiti tempore ferret opem:</l>
  <l n="402">ferret opem certe, si non ope, mater, egeret,</l>
  <l n="403">quae facta est uno mater et orba die.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="404">nata simul, moritura simul, simul ite sub undas</l>
  <l n="405">corpora.'</l>
  <l n="406">desierat, deposuitque sinu.</l>
  <l n="407">vagierunt ambo pariter: sensisse putares;</l>
  <l n="408">hi redeunt udis in sua tecta genis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="409">sustinet impositos summa cavus alveus unda:</l>
  <l n="410">heu quantum fati parva tabella tulit!</l>
  <l n="411">alveus in limo silvis adpulsus opacis</l>
  <l n="412">paulatim fluvio deficiente sedet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="413">arbor erat: remanent vestigia, quaeque vocatur</l>
  <l n="414">Rumina nunc ficus Romula ficus erat.</l>
  <l n="415">venit ad expositos, mirum, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupa</name> feta gemellos:</l>
  <l n="416">quis credat pueris non nocuisse feram?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="417">non nocuisse parum est, prodest quoque. quos <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupa</name> nutrit,</l>
  <l n="418">perdere cognatae sustinuere manus.</l>
  <l n="419">constitit et cauda teneris blanditur alumnis,</l>
  <l n="420">et fingit lingua corpora bina sua.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="421">Marte satos scires: timor abfuit. ubera ducunt</l>
  <l n="422">nec sibi promissi lactis aluntur ope.</l>
  <l n="423">illa loco nomen fecit, locus ipse Lupercis;</l>
  <l n="424">magna dati nutrix praemia lactis habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="425">Quid vetat Arcadio dictos a monte Lupercos?</l>
  <l n="426">Faunus in Arcadia templa Lycaeus habet.</l>
  <l n="427">Nupta, quid exspectas? non tu pollentibus herbis</l>
  <l n="428">nec prece nec magico carmine mater eris;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="429">excipe fecundae patienter verbera dextrae,</l>
  <l n="430">iam socer optatum nomen habebit avi.</l>
  <l n="431">nam fuit illa dies, dura cum sorte maritae</l>
  <l n="432">reddebant uteri pignora rara sui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="433">'quid mihi' clamabat 'prodest rapuisse Sabinas'</l>
</lg>
morceaux.19: Romulus hoc illo sceptra tenente fuit), 'si mea non vires, sed bellum iniuria fecit? utilius fuerat non habuisse nurus.' monte sub Esquilio multis incaeduus annis Iunonis magnae nomine lucus erat. huc ubi venerunt, pariter nuptaeque virique suppliciter posito procubuere genu: cum subito motae tremuere cacumina silvae, et dea per lucos mira locuta suos. 'Italidas matres' inquit 'sacer hircus inito.' obstipuit dubio territa turba sono. augur erat, nomen longis intercidit annis: nuper ab Etrusca venerat exul humo; ille caprum mactat: iussae sua terga puellae pellibus exsectis percutienda dabant. luna resumebat decimo nova cornua motu, virque pater subito nuptaque mater erat. gratia Lucinae: dedit haec tibi nomina lucus, aut quia principium tu, dea, lucis habes. parce, precor, gravidis, facilis Lucina, puellis, maturumque utero molliter aufer onus. Orta dies fuerit, tu desine credere ventis; perdidit illius temporis aura fidem. flamina non constant, et sex reserata diebus carceris Aeolii ianua lata patet. iam levis obliqua subsedit Aquarius urna: proximus aetherios excipe, Piscis, equos. te memorant fratremque tuum (nam iuncta micatis signa) duos tergo sustinuisse deos. terribilem quondam fugiens Typhona Dione, tum, cum pro caelo Iuppiter arma tulit, venit ad Euphraten comitata Cupidine parvo, inque Palaestinae margine sedit aquae.
morceaux.20:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="465">populus <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">et</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">cannae</name> <name type="placeName">riparum</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">summa</name> tenebant,</l>
  <l n="466">spemque dabant <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">salices</name> <foreign xml:lang="la">hos</foreign> quoque posse tegi.</l>
  <l n="467">dum latet, insonuit vento <name type="placeName">nemus</name>: illa timore</l>
  <l n="468">pallet, et hostiles credit adesse <name type="deity">manus</name>,</l>
  <l n="469"><foreign xml:lang="la">utque</foreign> sinu tenuit natum, '<persName>succurrite</persName>, <name type="deity">nymphae</name>,</l>
  <l n="470">et <name type="deity">dis</name> auxilium ferte duobus' ait.</l>
  <l n="471">nec mora, prosiluit. <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pisces</name> subiere gemelli:</l>
  <l n="472">pro quo nunc, cernis, sidera nomen habent.</l>
  <l n="473">inde <name type="deity">nefas</name> ducunt genus hoc imponere mensis</l>
  <l n="474">nec violant timidi <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">piscibus</name> ora <name type="placeName">Syri</name>.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="16"/>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="474a"><foreign xml:lang="la">G EN</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">H</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">QVIR</foreign> : <foreign xml:lang="la">NP</foreign></l>
</lg>
morceaux.21:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="476">Proxima lux vacua est; at tertia dicta <name type="deity">Quirino</name>,</l>
  <l n="477">qui tenet hoc nomen (<persName>Romulus</persName> ante fuit),</l>
  <l n="478">sive quod hasta <foreign xml:lang="la">'curis'</foreign> priscis est dicta <persName>Sabinis</persName></l>
  <l n="479">(bellicus a telo venit in astra <name type="deity">deus</name>);</l>
  <l n="480">sive suum regi nomen posuere <persName>Quirites</persName>,</l>
  <l n="481">seu quia <persName>Romanis</persName> iunxerat ille <placeName>Cures</placeName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="482">nam pater armipotens postquam nova moenia vidit,</l>
  <l n="483">multaque <persName>Romulea</persName> bella peracta manu,</l>
  <l n="484">'<name type="deity">Iuppiter</name>', inquit 'habet <persName>Roman</persName>a potentia vires:</l>
  <l n="485">sanguinis officio non eget illa mei.</l>
  <l n="486">redde patri natum: quamvis intercidit alter,</l>
  <l n="487">pro se proque <persName>Remo</persName> qui mihi restat erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="488">"unus erit quem tu tolles in caerula caeli"</l>
  <l n="489">tu mihi dixisti: sint rata dicta <name type="deity">Iovis</name>.'</l>
  <l n="490"><name type="deity">Iuppiter</name> adnuerat: nutu tremefactus uterque</l>
  <l n="491">est polus, et caeli pondera novit <name type="deity">Atlas</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="492">est locus, antiqui <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Caprae</name> dixere paludem:</l>
  <l n="493">forte tuis illic, <persName>Romule</persName>, iura dabas.</l>
  <l n="494">sol fugit, et removent subeuntia nubila caelum,</l>
  <l n="495">et gravis effusis decidit imber aquis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="496">hinc tonat, hinc missis abrumpitur ignibus aether:</l>
  <l n="497">fit fuga, rex patriis astra petebat equis.</l>
  <l n="498">luctus erat, falsaeque patres in crimine caedis,</l>
  <l n="499">haesissetque animis forsitan illa fides;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="500">sed <persName>Proculus</persName> <persName>Longa</persName> veniebat <placeName>Iulius Alba</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="501">lunaque fulgebat, nec facis usus erat,</l>
  <l n="502">cum subito motu saepes tremuere sinistrae:</l>
  <l n="503">rettulit ille gradus, horrueruntque comae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="504">pulcher et humano maior trabeaque decorus</l>
  <l n="505"><persName>Romulus</persName> in media visus adesse via</l>
  <l n="506">et dixisse simul 'prohibe lugere <persName>Quirites</persName>,</l>
  <l n="507">nec violent lacrimis numina nostra suis:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.22:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="509">tura ferant placentque novum pia turba <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Quirinum</name>,</l>
  <l n="510">et patrias artes militiamque colant.'</l>
  <l n="511">iussit et in tenues oculis evanuit auras;</l>
  <l n="512">convocat hic populos iussaque verba refert.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="513">templa deo fiunt: collis quoque dictus ab illo est,</l>
  <l n="514">et referunt certi sacra paterna dies.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="515">Lux quoque cur eadem <foreign xml:lang="la">Stultorum</foreign> festa vocetur</l>
  <l n="516">accipe: parva quidem causa, sed apta, subest.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="517">non habuit doctos tellus antiqua colonos:</l>
  <l n="518">lassabant agiles aspera bella viros.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="519">plus erat in gladio quam curvo laudis aratro:</l>
  <l n="520">neglectus domino pauca ferebat ager.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="521">farra tamen veteres iaciebant, farra metebant,</l>
  <l n="522">primitias <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Cereri</name> farra resecta dabant:</l>
  <l n="523">usibus admoniti flammis torrenda dederunt,</l>
  <l n="524">multaque peccato damna tulere suo;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="525">nam modo verrebant nigras pro farre favillas,</l>
  <l n="526">nunc ipsas ignes corripuere casas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="527">facta dea est <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Fornax</name>: laeti <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Fornax</name> coloni</l>
  <l n="528">orant ut fruges temperet illa suas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="529">curio legitimis nunc <foreign xml:lang="la">Fornacalia</foreign> verbis</l>
  <l n="530">maximus indicit nec stata sacra facit:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="531">inque foro, multa circum pendente tabella,</l>
  <l n="532">signatur certa curia quaeque nota,</l>
  <l n="532a">stultaque pars populi quae sit sua curia nescit,</l>
  <l n="533">sed facit extrema sacra relata die.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.23:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="533">Est honor et tumulis, animas placare paternas,</l>
  <l n="534">parvaque in exstructas munera ferre pyras.</l>
  <l n="535">parva petunt manes: pietas pro divite grata est</l>
  <l n="536">munere; non avidos Styx habet ima deos.</l>
  <l n="537">tegula porrectis satis est velata coronis</l>
  <l n="538">et sparsae fruges parcaque mica salis,</l>
  <l n="539">inque mero mollita Ceres violaeque solutae:</l>
  <l n="540">haec habeat media testa relicta via.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="541">nec maiora veto, sed et his placabilis umbra est:</l>
  <l n="542">adde preces positis et sua verba focis.</l>
  <l n="543">hunc morem Aeneas, pietatis idoneus auctor,</l>
  <l n="544">attulit in terras, iuste Latine, tuas.</l>
  <l n="545">ille patris Genio sollemnia dona ferebat:</l>
  <l n="546">hinc populi ritus edidicere pios.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="547">at quondam, dum longa gerunt pugnacibus armis</l>
  <l n="548">bella, Parentales deseruere dies.</l>
  <l n="549">non impune fuit; nam dicitur omine ab isto</l>
  <l n="550">Roma suburbanis incaluisse rogis.</l>
  <l n="551">vix equidem credo: bustis exisse feruntur</l>
  <l n="52">et tacitae questi tempore noctis avi,</l>
  <l n="553">perque vias Urbis latosque ululasse per agros</l>
  <l n="554">deformes animas, volgus inane, ferunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="555">post ea praeteriti tumulis redduntur honores,</l>
  <l n="556">prodigiisque venit funeribusque modus.</l>
  <l n="557">dum tamen haec fiunt, viduae cessate puellae:</l>
  <l n="558">exspectet puros pinea taeda dies,</l>
  <l n="559">nec tibi, quae cupidae matura videbere matri,</l>
  <l n="560">comat virgineas hasta recurva comas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="561">conde tuas, Hymenaee, faces, et ab ignibus atris</l>
  <l n="562">aufer: habent alias maesta sepulcra faces.</l>
  <l n="563">di quoque templorum foribus celentur opertis,</l>
  <l n="564">ture vacent arae stentque sine igne foci.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.24:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="565">nunc <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">animae</name> tenues et corpora functa sepulcris</l>
  <l n="566">errant, nunc posito pascitur umbra cibo.</l>
  <l n="567">nec tamen haec ultra, quam tot de mense supersint</l>
  <l n="568"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Luciferi</name>, quot habent carmina nostra pedes.</l>
  <l n="569">hanc, quia iusta ferunt, dixere Feralia lucem;</l>
  <l n="570">ultima placandis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">manibus</name> illa dies.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="571">Ecce <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">anus</name> in mediis residens annosa puellis</l>
  <l n="572">sacra facit Tacitae (vix tamen ipsa tacet),</l>
  <l n="573">et digitis tria tura tribus sub limine ponit,</l>
  <l n="574">qua brevis occultum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">mus</name> sibi fecit iter:</l>
  <l n="575">tum cantata ligat cum fusco licia plumbo,</l>
  <l n="576">et septem nigras versat in ore fabas,</l>
  <l n="577">quodque pice adstrinxit, quod acu traiecit aena,</l>
  <l n="578">obsutum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">maenae</name> torret in igne caput;</l>
  <l n="579">vina quoque instillat: vini quodcumque relictum est,</l>
  <l n="580">aut ipsa aut comites, plus tamen ipsa, bibit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="581">'hostiles linguas inimicaque vinximus ora'</l>
  <l n="582">dicit discedens ebriaque exit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">anus</name>.</l>
  <l n="583">protinus a nobis quae sit dea Muta requires:</l>
  <l n="584">disce per antiquos quae mihi nota senes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="585"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iuppiter</name>, inmodico Iuturnae victus amore,</l>
  <l n="586">multa tulit tanto non patienda deo:</l>
  <l n="587">illa modo in silvis inter coryleta latebat,</l>
  <l n="588">nunc in cognatas desiliebat aquas.</l>
  <l n="589">convocat hic nymphas, Latium quaecumque tenebant,</l>
  <l n="590">et iacit in medio talia verba choro:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="591">'invidet ipsa sibi vitatque quod expedit illi</l>
  <l n="592">vestra soror, summo iungere membra deo.</l>
  <l n="593">consulite ambobus: nam quae mea magna voluptas,</l>
  <l n="594">utilitas vestrae magna sororis erit.</l>
  <l n="595">vos illi in prima fugienti obsistite ripa,</l>
  <l n="596">ne sua fluminea corpora mergat aqua.'</l>
</lg>
morceaux.25:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="597">dixerat; adnuerant nymphae Tiberinides omnes</l>
  <l n="598">quaeque colunt thalamos, Ilia diva, tuos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="599">forte fuit Nais, Lara nomine; prima sed illi</l>
  <l n="600">dicta bis antiquum syllaba nomen erat,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="601">ex vitio positum. saepe illi dixerat Almo</l>
  <l n="602">'nata, tene linguam': nec tamen illa tenet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="603">quae simul ac tetigit Iuturnae stagna sororis,</l>
  <l n="604">'effuge' ait 'ripas', dicta refertque Iovis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="605">illa etiam Iunonem adiit, miserataque nuptas</l>
  <l n="606">'Naida Iuturnam vir tuus' inquit 'amat.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="607">Iuppiter intumuit, quaque est non usa modeste</l>
  <l n="608">eripit huic linguam, Mercuriumque vocat:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="609">'duc hanc ad manes: locus ille silentibus aptus.</l>
  <l n="610">nympha, sed infernae nympha paludis erit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="611">iussa Iovis fiunt. accepit lucus euntes:</l>
  <l n="612">dicitur illa duci tum placuisse deo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="613">vim parat hic, voltu pro verbis illa precatur,</l>
  <l n="614">et frustra muto nititur ore loqui,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="615">fitque gravis geminosque parit, qui compita servant</l>
  <l n="616">et vigilant nostra semper in urbe <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Lares</name>.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.26:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="619">Proxima cognati dixere Karistia <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">kari</name>,</l>
  <l n="620">et venit ad socios turba propinqua deos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="621">scilicet a tumulis et qui periere propinquis</l>
  <l n="622">protinus ad vivos ora referre iuvat,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="623">postque tot amissos quicquid de sanguine restat</l>
  <l n="624">aspicere et generis dinumerare gradus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="625">innocui veniant: procul hinc, procul impius esto</l>
  <l n="626">frater et in partus mater acerba suos,</l>
  <l n="627">cui pater est vivax, qui matris digerit annos,</l>
  <l n="628">quae premit invisam socrus iniqua nurum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="629">Tantalidae fratres absint et Iasonis uxor,</l>
  <l n="630">et quae ruricolis semina tosta dedit,</l>
  <l n="631">et soror et Procne Tereusque duabus iniquus</l>
  <l n="632">et quicumque suas per scelus auget opes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="633">dis generis date tura boni: Concordia fertur</l>
  <l n="634">illa praecipue mitis adesse die;</l>
  <l n="635">et libate dapes, ut, grati pignus honoris,</l>
  <l n="636">nutriat incinctos missa patella Lares.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="637">iamque, ubi suadebit placidos nox umida somnos,</l>
  <l n="638">larga precaturi sumite vina manu,</l>
  <l n="639">et 'bene vos, bene te, patriae pater, optime Caesar'</l>
  <l n="640">dicite; suffuso sint bona verba mero.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="23"/>
<note type="marginalia">F TER : NP    638a</note>
morceaux.27:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="641">Nox ubi transierit, solito celebretur honore</l>
  <l n="642">separat indicio qui deus <name type="deity">arva</name> suo.</l>
  <l n="643">Termine, sive lapis sive es defossus in agro</l>
  <l n="644">stipes, ab antiquis tu quoque <name type="deity">numen</name> habes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="645">te duo diversa domini de parte coronant,</l>
  <l n="646">binaque serta tibi binaque liba ferunt.</l>
  <l n="647">ara fit: huc ignem curto fert rustica testo</l>
  <l n="648">sumptum de tepidis ipsa colona focis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="649">ligna senex minuit concisaque construit arte,</l>
  <l n="650">et solida ramos figere pugnat humo;</l>
  <l n="651">tum sicco primas inritat cortice flammas;</l>
  <l n="652">stat puer et manibus lata canistra tenet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="653">inde ubi ter fruges medios immisit in ignes,</l>
  <l n="654">porrigit incisos filia parva favos.</l>
  <l n="655">vina tenent alii: libantur singula flammis;</l>
  <l n="656">spectant, et linguis candida turba favet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="657">spargitur et caeso communis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Terminus</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">agno</name>,</l>
  <l n="658">nec queritur lactans cum sibi <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">porca</name> datur.</l>
  <l n="659">conveniunt celebrantque dapes vicinia simplex</l>
  <l n="660">et cantant laudes, <name type="deity">Termine</name> sancte, tuas:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="661">'tu populos urbesque et regna ingentia finis:</l>
  <l n="662">omnis erit sine te litigiosus ager.</l>
  <l n="663">nulla tibi ambitio est, nullo corrumperis auro,</l>
  <l n="664">legitima servas credita rura fide.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="665">si tu signasses olim <placeName>Thyreatida</placeName> terram,</l>
  <l n="666">corpora non leto missa trecenta forent,</l>
  <l n="667">nec foret <persName>Othryades</persName> congestis lectus in armis.</l>
  <l n="668">o quantum patriae sanguinis ille dedit!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="669">quid, nova cum fierent <placeName>Capitolia</placeName>? nempe deorum</l>
  <l n="670">cuncta <name type="deity">Iovi</name> cessit turba locumque dedit;</l>
  <l n="671"><name type="deity">Terminus</name>, ut veteres memorant, inventus in aede</l>
  <l n="672">restitit et magno cum <name type="deity">Iove</name> templa tenet.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.28:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="671">nunc quoque, se supra ne quid nisi sidera cernat,</l>
  <l n="672">exiguum templi tecta foramen habent.</l>
  <l n="673">Termine, post illud levitas tibi libera non est:</l>
  <l n="674">qua positus fueris in statione, mane;</l>
  <l n="675">nec tu vicino quicquam concede roganti,</l>
  <l n="676">ne videare hominem praeposuisse Iovi:</l>
  <l n="677">et seu vomeribus seu tu pulsabere rastris,</l>
  <l n="678">clamato "tuus est hic ager, ille tuus".'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="679">est via quae populum Laurentes ducit in agros,</l>
  <l n="680">quondam Dardanio regna petita duci:</l>
  <l n="681">illa lanigeri pecoris tibi, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Termine</name>, fibris</l>
  <l n="682">sacra videt fieri sextus ab Urbe lapis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="683">gentibus est aliis tellus data limite certo:</l>
  <l n="684">Romanae spatium est Urbis et orbis idem.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.29:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="689">Nunc mihi dicenda est <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">regis</name> fuga. traxit ab illa</l>
  <l n="690">sextus ab extremo nomina mense dies.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="691">ultima Tarquinius Romanae gentis habebat</l>
  <l n="692"><persName>regna</persName>, vir iniustus, fortis ad arma tamen.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="693">ceperat hic alias, alias everterat urbes,</l>
  <l n="694">et <placeName>Gabios</placeName> turpi fecerat arte suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="695">namque trium minimus, proles manifesta Superbi,</l>
  <l n="696">in medios hostes nocte silente venit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="697">nudarant gladios: 'occidite' dixit 'inermem:</l>
  <l n="698">hoc cupiant fratres Tarquiniusque pater,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="699">qui mea crudeli laceravit verbere terga'</l>
  <l n="700">(dicere ut hoc posset, verbera passus erat).</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="701">luna fuit: spectant iuvenem, gladiosque recondunt,</l>
  <l n="702">tergaque, deducta veste, notata vident:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="703">flent quoque, et ut secum tueatur bella precantur.</l>
  <l n="704">callidus ignaris adnuit ille viris.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="705">iamque potens misso genitorem appellat amico,</l>
  <l n="706">perdendi <placeName>Gabios</placeName> quod sibi monstret iter.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="707">hortus odoratis suberat cultissimus <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbis</name>,</l>
  <l n="708">sectus humum rivo lene sonantis <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="709">illic Tarquinius mandata latentia nati</l>
  <l n="710">accipit, et virga <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lilia</name> summa metit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="711">nuntius ut rediit decussaque <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lilia</name> dixit,</l>
  <l n="712">filius 'agnosco iussa parentis' ait.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="713">nec mora, principibus caesis ex urbe <placeName>Gabina</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="714">traduntur ducibus moenia nuda suis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="715">ecce, nefas visu, mediis altaribus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">anguis</name></l>
  <l n="716">exit et exstinctis ignibus exta rapit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="717">consulitur Phoebus. sors est ita reddita: 'matri</l>
  <l n="718">qui dederit princeps oscula, victor erit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="719">oscula quisque suae matri properata tulerunt,</l>
  <l n="719">non intellecto credula turba deo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="720">Brutus erat stulti sapiens imitator, ut esset</l>
</lg>
morceaux.30:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="720">tutus ab insidiis, <name type="deity">dire Superbe</name>, tuis.</l>
  <l n="721">ille iacens pronus matri dedit oscula <name type="deity">Terrae</name>,</l>
  <l n="722">creditus offenso procubuisse pede.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="723">cingitur interea <placeName>Romanis</placeName> <placeName>Ardea</placeName> signis,</l>
  <l n="724">et patitur longas obsidione moras.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="725">dum vacat et metuunt hostes committere pugnam,</l>
  <l n="726">luditur in castris, otia miles agit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="727"><persName>Tarquinius</persName> iuvenis socios dapibusque meroque</l>
  <l n="728">accipit; ex illis rege creatus ait:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="729">'dum nos sollicitos pigro tenet <placeName>Ardea</placeName> bello,</l>
  <l n="730">nec sinit ad patrios arma referre deos,</l>
  <l n="731">ecquid in officio torus est socialis? et ecquid</l>
  <l n="732">coniugibus nostris mutua cura sumus?'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="733">quisque suam laudat: studiis certamina crescunt,</l>
  <l n="734">et fervet multo linguaque corque mero.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="735">surgit cui dederat clarum <placeName>Collatia</placeName> nomen:</l>
  <l n="736">'non opus est verbis, credite rebus' ait.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="737">'nox superest: tollamur equis <placeName>Urbem</placeName>que petamus';</l>
  <l n="738">dicta placent, frenis impediuntur equi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="739">pertulerant dominos. regalia protinus illi</l>
  <l n="740">tecta petunt: custos in fore nullus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="741">ecce nurum regis fusis per colla coronis</l>
  <l n="742">inveniunt posito pervigilare mero.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="743">inde cito passu petitur <persName>Lucretia</persName>, cuius</l>
  <l n="744">ante torum calathi lanaque mollis erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="745">lumen ad exiguum famulae data pensa trahebant;</l>
  <l n="746">inter quas tenui sic ait illa sono:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="747">'mittenda est domino (nunc, nunc properate, puellae)</l>
  <l n="748">quamprimum nostra facta lacerna manu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="749">quid tamen auditis (nam plura audire potestis)?</l>
  <l n="750">quantum de bello dicitur esse super?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="751">postmodo victa cades: melioribus, <placeName>Ardea</placeName>, restas,</l>
  <l n="752">improba, quae nostros cogis abesse viros.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.31:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="751">sint tantum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">reduces</name>. sed enim temerarius ille</l>
  <l n="752">est meus, et stricto qualibet ense ruit.</l>
  <l n="753">mens abit et morior, quotiens pugnantis imago</l>
  <l n="754">me subit, et gelidum pectora frigus habet.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="755">desinit in lacrimas inceptaque fila remisit,</l>
  <l n="756">in gremio voltum deposuitque suum.</l>
  <l n="757">hoc ipsum decuit: lacrimae decuere pudicam,</l>
  <l n="758">et facies animo dignaque parque fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="759">'pone metum, veni' coniunx ait; illa revixit,</l>
  <l n="760">deque viri collo dulce pependit onus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="761">interea iuvenis furiales regius ignes</l>
  <l n="762">concipit, et caeco raptus amore furit.</l>
  <l n="763">forma placet niveusque color flavique capilli</l>
  <l n="764">quique aderat nulla factus ab arte decor:</l>
  <l n="765">verba placent et vox et quod corrumpere non est;</l>
  <l n="766">quoque minor spes est, hoc magis ille cupit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="767">iam dederat cantus lucis praenuntius <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ales</name>,</l>
  <l n="768">cum referunt iuvenes in sua castra pedem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="769">carpitur attonitos absentis imagine sensus</l>
  <l n="770">ille; recordanti plura magisque placent.</l>
  <l n="771">sic sedit, sic culta fuit, sic stamina nevit,</l>
  <l n="772">iniectae collo sic iacuere comae,</l>
  <l n="773">hos habuit voltus, haec illi verba fuerunt,</l>
  <l n="774">hic color, haec facies, hic decor oris erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="775">ut solet a magno fluctus languescere flatu,</l>
  <l n="776">sed tamen a vento, qui fuit, unda tumet,</l>
  <l n="777">sic, quamvis aberat placitae praesentia formae,</l>
  <l n="778">quem dederat praesens forma, manebat amor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="779">ardet, et iniusti stimulis agitatus amoris</l>
  <l n="780">comparat indigno vimque metumque toro.</l>
  <l n="781">'exitus in dubio est: audebimus ultima' dixit:</l>
  <l n="782">viderit! audentes forsque deusque iuvat.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.32:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="781">cepimus audendo <name type="placeName">Gabios</name> quoque.'</l>
  <l n="782">talia fatus</l>
  <l n="783">ense latus cinxit tergaque pressit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equi</name>.</l>
  <l n="784">accipit aerata <persName>iuvenem</persName> <placeName>Collatia</placeName> porta,</l>
  <l n="785">condere iam voltus sole parante suos.</l>
  <l n="786"><name type="deity">hostis</name> ut hospes init penetralia <persName>Collatini</persName>:</l>
  <l n="787">comiter excipitur; sanguine iunctus erat.</l>
  <l n="788">quantum animis erroris inest! parat inscia rerum</l>
  <l n="789">infelix epulas <name type="deity">hostibus</name> illa suis.</l>
  <l n="790">functus erat dapibus: poscunt sua tempora somnum;</l>
  <l n="791">nox erat, et tota lumina nulla domo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="792">surgit et aurata vagina liberat ensem</l>
  <l n="793">et venit in thalamos, nupta pudica, tuos;</l>
  <l n="794">utque torum pressit, 'ferrum, <persName>Lucretia</persName>, mecum est'</l>
  <l n="795">natus ait regis, '<persName>Tarquinius</persName>que loquor.'</l>
  <l n="796">illa nihil, neque enim vocem viresque loquendi</l>
  <l n="797">aut aliquid toto pectore mentis habet;</l>
  <l n="798">sed tremit, ut quondam stabulis deprensa relictis</l>
  <l n="799">parva sub infesto cum iacet <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">agna</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupo</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="800">quid faciat? pugnet? vincetur femina pugnans.</l>
  <l n="801">clamet? at in dextra, qui vetet, ensis erat.</l>
  <l n="802">effugiat? positis urgentur pectora palmis,</l>
  <l n="803">tum primum externa pectora tacta manu.</l>
  <l n="804">instat amans <name type="deity">hostis</name> precibus pretioque minisque:</l>
  <l n="805">nec prece nec pretio nec movet ille minis.</l>
  <l n="806">'nil agis: eripiam' dixit 'per crimina vitam:</l>
  <l n="807">falsus adulterii testis adulter ero:</l>
  <l n="808">interimam famulum, cum quo deprensa fereris.'</l>
  <l n="809">succubuit famae victa puella metu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="810">quid, victor, gaudes? haec te victoria perdet.</l>
  <l n="811">heu quanto regnis nox stetit una tuis!</l>
  <l n="812">iamque erat orta dies: passis sedet illa capillis,</l>
  <l n="813">ut solet ad nati mater itura rogum,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.33:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="815">grandaevumque patrem fido cum coniuge <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">castris</name>    </l>
  <l n="816">evocat: et posita venit uterque mora. </l>
  <l n="817">utque vident habitum, quae luctus causa, requirunt, </l>
  <l n="818">cui paret exsequias, quoque sit icta malo. </l>
  <l n="819">illa diu reticet pudibundaque celat amictu </l>
  <l n="820">ora: fluunt lacrimae more perennis <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>.   </l>
  <l n="821">hinc pater, hinc coniunx lacrimas solantur et orant </l>
  <l n="822">indicet et caeco flentque paventque metu. </l>
  <l n="823">ter conata loqui ter destitit, ausaque quarto </l>
  <l n="824">non oculos ideo sustulit illa suos. </l>
  <l n="825">'hoc quoque Tarquinio debebimus? eloquar' inquit, </l>
  <l n="826">'eloquar infelix dedecus ipsa meum?' </l>
  <l n="827">quaeque potest, narrat; restabant ultima: flevit, </l>
  <l n="828">et matronales erubuere genae. </l>
  <l n="829">dant veniam facto genitor coniunxque coactae: </l>
  <l n="830">'quam' dixit 'veniam vos datis, ipsa nego.'   </l>
  <l n="831">nec mora, celato fixit sua pectora <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ferro</name>, </l>
  <l n="832">et cadit in patrios sanguinulenta pedes. </l>
  <l n="833">tum quoque iam moriens ne non procumbat honeste </l>
  <l n="834">respicit: haec etiam cura cadentis erat. </l>
  <l n="835">ecce super corpus, communia damna gementes, </l>
  <l n="836">obliti decoris virque paterque iacent. </l>
  <l n="837"><persName>Brutus</persName> adest, tandemque animo sua nomina fallit, </l>
  <l n="838">fixaque semanimi corpore tela rapit, </l>
  <l n="839">stillantemque tenens generoso sanguine cultrum </l>
  <l n="840">edidit impavidos ore minante sonos:   </l>
  <l n="841">'per tibi ego hunc iuro fortem castumque cruorem, </l>
  <l n="842">perque tuos manes, qui mihi numen erunt, </l>
  <l n="843"><placeName>Tarquinium</placeName> profuga poenas cum stirpe daturum. </l>
  <l n="844">iam satis est virtus dissimulata diu.' </l>
  <l n="845">illa iacens ad verba oculos sine lumine movit, </l>
  <l n="846">visaque concussa dicta probare coma. </l>
</lg>
morceaux.34:
<head>Halieutica</head>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="847">fertur in exsequias animi matrona virilis</l>
  <l n="848">et secum lacrimas invidiamque trahit.</l>
  <l n="849">volnus inane patet: Brutus clamore Quirites</l>
  <l n="850">concitat et regis facta nefanda refert.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="851">Tarquinius cum prole fugit: capit annua consul</l>
  <l n="852">iura: dies regnis illa suprema fuit.</l>
  <l n="853">Fallimur, an veris praenuntia venit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hirundo</name>,</l>
  <l n="854">nec metuit ne qua versa recurrat hiems?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="855">saepe tamen, <persName>Procne</persName>, nimium properasse quereris,</l>
  <l n="856">virque tuo <persName>Tereus</persName> frigore laetus erit.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="856a"/>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="857">Iamque duae restant noctes de mense secundo,</l>
  <l n="858"><name type="deity">Mars</name>que citos iunctis curribus urget equos;</l>
  <l n="859">ex vero positum permansit <foreign xml:lang="la">Equirria</foreign> nomen,</l>
  <l n="860">quae deus in campo prospicit ipse suo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="861">iure venis, <persName>Gradive</persName>: locum tua tempora poscunt,</l>
  <l n="862">signatusque tuo nomine mensis adest.</l>
  <l n="863">venimus in portum libro cum mense peracto.</l>
  <l n="864">naviget hinc alia iam mihi linter aqua.</l>
</lg>
<persName>Ovidius</persName>
